To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Na + ion conductor Na0.7Ga4.7Ti0.3O8 can be ion exchanged with LiNO3 and KNO3 to produce Li+ and K+ conductors, respectively.
the Na 0.5 Ga 4.5 Ti 0.5 O 8 compound was synthesized and characterized by X-ray diffraction and the electrical conductivity of this material was determined.
the Na0.7Ga4.7Ti0.3O8 material was synthesized, and that the electrical properties of the material were studied as a function of temperature, cation exchange and composition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of one-dimensional ion conducting oxides, AxGa 4+ XTi 1−x O 8, where A = Li, Na and X = 0, 0.2, 0.5.
the synthesis and transport studies of the one-dimensional ion conductive materials AxGa4+ XTi1−x O8 (A = Na, K; X = Li).
the synthesis and characterization of one-dimensional ion-conducting oxides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ion exchange with LiNO3 results in an increase in the ionic conductivity of Na0.7Ga4.7Ti0.3O8, whereas exchange with K+ salts has little effect on the electrical properties.
ion exchange reactions can have a significant effect on the electrical conductivity of the material.
the conductivity of the Na 0.3 Ga 4.6 Ti 0.4 O 8 material is enhanced by the exchange of the sodium ions by lithium ions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the ion exchange reaction of Na 0.5 Ga 4.5 Ti 0.5 O 8 with LiNO 2 at 450 °C for 24 h produced a material with a conductivity of 10 − 5 S/cm at 500 °C, which is an improvement of two orders of magnitude over the parent compound.
we are able to successfully synthesize the one dimensional ion conductors Na 0.6 K 0.4 Ga 4.4 Ti 0.6 O 8 and K 0.6 Ga 4.6 Ti 0.4 O 8, as well as Na 0.3 Li 0.7 K 0.1 Ga 4.8 Ti 0.2 O 8.
the ion exchange reactions are dependent on the size of the cations and their ability to be accommodated into the structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to synthesize one-dimensional ion conductive materials with the same structure as Na 0.75 Ga 4.75 Ti 0.25 O 8.
ion exchange can be used as a tool to modify the properties of a material in a predictable manner.
the ion exchange reaction can be used to tune the conductivity of the material.
